name: Presque Isle Passage RV Park & Cabin Rentals
note: Mostly seasonal and monthly: 39 of its ~99 RV sites (the pull-throughs by the pool and the 100s row) are sold by the night, the rest are seasonal or monthly on the operator's 2025 site map; also ~30 rental cabins, park models and yurts. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site (read 2026-10-21: RV sites mostly pull-thrus 'for any size RV', 30/50 A full hookups, 2025 site map: 31 full-hookup + 8 buddy nightly sites, 50 seasonal, 10 monthly, tent area, rentals) + Campspot engine (park 1904, read 2026-10-21) selling single weekday nights on all 39 nightly RV sites to 60 ft with no application, Fri/Sat 2-night minimum; Esri imagery at 42.0223,-80.1868 shows diagonal gravel pull-through pads with RVs by the pool; Google Maps 4.4 (850 reviews), open, phone 814-833-3272; 6300 Sterrettania Rd Fairview, a different park from Erie KOA (McKean) -> real transient RV campground beside a seasonal section; price gate lifted: within 40 km of a family home (gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-21 audit: the only water on site is a small catch-and-release fishing pond at the far NW corner of the park (operator 2025 site map: beside the private residence and tent area, ringed by road, no RV site on it; Esri imagery confirms a small dark pond by the buildings ~400 m NW of the nightly pads). The nightly pull-throughs by the pool (pinned 42.0223,-80.1868) sit among lawn and seasonal rows with no water in sight; Lake Erie is ~7 mi away (operator: '7 miles to the beach') -> not waterfront.
fees_source: https://www.campspot.com/book/presqueislepassagerv site-type 18576 'Pullthrough 50/30/20 AMP W/S/E' (max 60 ft), 2 adults, read 2026-10-21: $61.00 x 1 night weekday Apr-May/Sep-Oct 2027 (2027-05-11), $66.00 x 1 night weekday Jun-Jul 2027 (2027-06-15, 2027-07-13), $70.00/night Fri+Sat 2027-07-16..18; no park fee lines, only tax (6%) and Campspot's own $3 / 3% booking fee. Buddy sites same price; primitive tent sites $30-35. Additional adults $3/night (operator campsites page).

booking.note: Campspot enforces a 2-night minimum on RV sites for Friday/Saturday arrivals (RESERVATION_MIN_RULE on 2027-05-14, 06-19 and 07-16); single weekday nights sell with no minimum. Optional 4- and 6-week 'leave your RV on site, stay any 3 nights each week' weekend packages are sold separately.

booking_source: Campspot availability API, park 1904, quotes for 2027-04-06 through 2027-10-12 read 2026-10-21
flags: Nightly share read off the 2025 site map legend (Full Hookup + Buddy = 39 nightly, Seasonal blue = 50, Monthly red = 10) and matches Campspot's 31 + 8 bookable RV sites; 39% clears 1 in 10 easily.
Season: Campspot sells RV nights from at least 2027-04-06 through 2027-10-12 and returns nothing for Nov-Mar dates (closed in winter); exact open/close dates not published.
nightly_low is the shoulder weekday rate ($61); the June-July weekday rate is $66.
The 4-/6-week 'leave your RV' packages are optional weekend products, not a requirement; nights are sold singly midweek.
